message:
I remember the time when a sudden storm knocked out our power for a couple of days. Thankfully, I had taken the time to gather a few essentials in a kit, just like I’d read about. It felt like such a small win at the time, but having those supplies ready truly made a difference. It was comforting to have flashlights, some snacks, and even a few games to keep the grandkids entertained. 

Preparation doesn’t have to be daunting; it can be as simple as picking up a few items and putting them in one place. It’s all about those little steps that can save the day when you least expect it. What’s your favorite preparedness tip?
